question: As per the standard census definition. main worker is a person who works for at least _____ in a year.
solution:
The correct answer is __**183 days**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **A main worker **is defined as a person who has worked for** at least 183 days** in a year.
 
• This definition is used in the standard census to classify individuals based on their employment status.
 
• Based mostly on their work, employees were divided into main and minor workers.
